reason: After reviewing the Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (AMRX) 10-K filing excerpt, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company itself. The filing contains detailed segment revenue breakdowns by dosage form (oral solid, injectable, transdermal, biosimilar, etc.) and therapeutic classes (CNS, hormonal/allergy, etc.), customer concentration data, and various financial metrics. However, the company did not publish any market size estimates, addressable market figures, or TAM disclosures in this filing. All revenue data presented reflects actual company performance rather than market opportunity sizing.
